symbols.name: cyclic variable
symbols.meaning: The formal variable of the cyclic ring $\mathbb C[z]/(z^r-1)$, whose exponents wrap modulo $r$.
symbols.quote: Let $z$ be the variable of the cyclic ring $\mathbb C[z]/(z^r-1)$, whose exponents wrap modulo $r$.

symbols.name: twist constant
symbols.meaning: The complex number $e^{\pi \mathrm i/r}$, whose $r$th power is $-1$, used to scale the twist.
symbols.quote: Let $\zeta=e^{\pi \mathrm i/r}$, where $\mathrm i$ is the imaginary unit, so $\zeta^r=-1$.

symbols.name: last-axis index
symbols.meaning: An index of a coefficient on the last axis, with $0\le k<r$.
symbols.quote: Let $k$ index a last-axis coefficient, $0\le k<r$. On this page $k$ and $l$ index the last axis, replacing their meanings on the Convolution page.

symbols.name: second last-axis index
symbols.meaning: A second index of a last-axis coefficient, paired with $k$ in a product.
symbols.quote: On this page $k$ and $l$ index the last axis, replacing their meanings on the Convolution page.

symbols.name: cyclic product index
symbols.meaning: The cyclic index of a product coefficient, with $0\le j<r$.
symbols.quote: For $k+l=j+hr$ with $0\le j<r$ and $h\in\{0,1\}$, where $j$ is the cyclic index of the product and $h$ records whether the exponent wrapped (here $h$ is not the carry of the radix-digit page), the cyclic product is $z^{k+l}=z^j$.

symbols.name: wrap bit
symbols.meaning: The bit recording whether the exponent $k+l$ wrapped past $r$, so $h\in\{0,1\}$; not the radix carry $h_k$.
symbols.quote: For $k+l=j+hr$ with $0\le j<r$ and $h\in\{0,1\}$, where $j$ is the cyclic index of the product and $h$ records whether the exponent wrapped (here $h$ is not the carry of the radix-digit page), the cyclic product is $z^{k+l}=z^j$.

symbols.name: twisted ring
symbols.meaning: The polynomial ring $\mathbb C[y]/(y^r+1)$, in which the entries on the remaining axes lie.
symbols.quote: Let $R=\mathbb C[y]/(y^r+1)$, so each entry on those axes is an element of $R$.

symbols.name: remaining-axis index
symbols.meaning: A tuple with one coordinate per remaining cyclic axis, each wrapping modulo its length.
symbols.quote: For the other axes, index tuples $v$ with one coordinate per remaining cyclic axis, each wrapping modulo its length.

symbols.name: first entry coefficients
symbols.meaning: The coefficients $\alpha_k$ of the first entry of a product, indexed by last-axis position $k$.
symbols.quote: Write $\alpha_k$ and $\beta_l$ for the coefficients of two entries, $\sum_k \alpha_k\zeta^k y^k$ and $\sum_l \beta_l\zeta^l y^l$.

symbols.name: second entry coefficients
symbols.meaning: The coefficients $\beta_l$ of the second entry of a product, indexed by last-axis position $l$.
symbols.quote: Write $\alpha_k$ and $\beta_l$ for the coefficients of two entries, $\sum_k \alpha_k\zeta^k y^k$ and $\sum_l \beta_l\zeta^l y^l$.

relations.predicate: turns the last cyclic coordinate into
relations.quote: The twist turns the last cyclic coordinate into the [Polynomial ring modulo $y^r+1$](poly-ring-y-r.md).

The twist is applied after [Bluestein's chirp identity](bluestein-chirp.md) has turned the middle transform into a cyclic convolution, and it lets the remaining axes be convolved over a polynomial ring.
The twist converts the cyclic wrap of [Convolution](convolution.md) on the last axis into a negative wrap in $R$.
